checks.label: Duplicate payment verification
checks.detail: No high-confidence duplicates after filtering 345 batch payments and 30835 CSV overlaps. Previous false positives eliminated.

checks.label: Split payment analysis
checks.detail: 753 suspect instances (£339.8M, 6.8% of spend). Threshold: 5+ payments to same supplier in same week, 80%+ of approval limit.

checks.label: Year-end spike verification
checks.detail: Highest spike: 5.3x in Adult Care & Health. Year-end spikes are common in public sector (capital programmes, grants). Only extreme spikes (>3x) warrant concern.

checks.label: CH compliance — pre-breach only
checks.detail: 3 suppliers have current breaches, but all payments were made before breaches started. Not violations at time of payment.

checks.label: Benford's Law forensic screening
checks.detail: Significant deviation from Benford's Law (p < 0.001). χ²=49459.65 on 660944 amounts >£100. Largest deviation: digit 3 (4.7% off expected).

warnings: Benford's Law analysis shows significant deviation (χ²=49459.65). Digit 3 deviates 4.7% from expected. This warrants investigation but can also occur with legitimate round-number grants or threshold-based payments.
